repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable foundations, shared operating rules, semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, successor preview, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests. V6 remains production; G7 is unfrozen. Coordinated shell certification stays in isolated G7; FIRE Core remains blocked until explicit shell freeze.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Lab is evidence, never authority. Active Fire/World experiments remain isolated from production runtime/data; there is no active full FIRE shell replica.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: World experiments currently live under babel-lab/world/. A real World product earns its own repo later; Babel Lab itself does not become World.
